groups.defect: The credential-sharing branch returns a raw fetch Response that callers expecting parsed provider token objects cannot consume.
groups.rationale: These describe the same return-contract mismatch from the helper and its Google call site. The additional affected providers illustrate the same defect.

groups.defect: Google Calendar persists the SafeParse result wrapper as the credential key instead of its parsed data.
groups.rationale: All four identify the same assignment and database write, resolved by unwrapping the parsed payload.

groups.defect: A missing refresh token is replaced with a literal placeholder that can overwrite the stored valid refresh token.
groups.rationale: One reports the placeholder insertion in the helper; the other reports its propagation through the Office365 credential merge. Both describe the same credential-corruption defect.

groups.defect: Zoho Bigin passes a credential ID into the userId parameter, causing the sync request to carry the wrong calcomUserId.
groups.rationale: All six identify the same argument mismatch. The suggestion attached to the helper signature describes that same caller disagreement, which fixing the Bigin argument resolves.

groups.defect: Throwing on parse failure makes callers' failure-result branches unreachable and changes previously tolerant refresh flows into aborting failures.
groups.rationale: Both explicitly report the unreachable Salesforce failure guard caused by the helper throwing. The broader suggestion additionally reports the behavioral regression in formerly best-effort refresh flows.
